author: mdgamer
what_it_is: Save of game played to abilty to trade Mudkip so you can complete your Pokedex on another game.
format: SharkPort save ("SharkPortSave", kind 0x000F0000): title "Pokemon Ruby", date "Trade Mudkip", notes "Played game up to a point where you can trade away a Mudk..."; cart header "POKEMON RUBY" / 'AXVE' (complement 0x41); payload 65536 bytes; checksum: unsigned

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/gba-sharkport.py pokemon-ruby-sapphire-emerald-version.3749.sps --rom ROM --core CORE --outdir DIR: reads the SharkPort container as mGBA does and imports the payload as mGBA's _importSavedata does (cut to the chip, EEPROM 8-byte blocks reversed, the rest of the chip erased), then lays the chip out as the core keeps it
